name: Daily digest of stale Inistate approvals

parameters.content:
## Daily digest of stale Inistate approvals

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning to identify stale Inistate approval entries. It sets the digest parameters, queries Inistate for entries in the pending state older than the configured threshold, aggregates the results, builds an HTML email digest, and sends it to the configured recipient.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule on the "Every morning" trigger to match the desired daily send time and timezone.
- Set the values in "Settings", including pendingState, staleDays, digestTo, and fromEmail.
- Connect and authorize the Inistate node so it can search the relevant approval entries.
- Configure email sending credentials and sender settings for the "Send digest" node.

### Customization

Adjust staleDays, pendingState, recipients, and the digest HTML/subject to match the approval process and reporting format.

## Schedule and settings

Starts the workflow on a daily schedule and defines the parameters used to find stale approvals and send the digest.

## Find and collect entries

Searches Inistate for stale pending approval entries and aggregates the returned items into a collection for the digest.

## Build and send digest

Creates the email subject and HTML body from the collected entries, then sends the daily digest email.

assignments.name: subject
assignments.value: ={{ $json.entries.length + ' entries waiting over ' + $('Set Digest Parameters').item.json.staleDays + ' days for approval' }}

assignments.name: html
assignments.value:
={{ '

These entries have been in ' + String($('Set Digest Parameters').item.json.pendingState ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' })[c]) + ' for more than ' + $('Set Digest Parameters').item.json.staleDays + ' days:

' + $json.entries.map(e => '').join('') + '
EntryLast updatedByAssigned to
' + String(e.documentId ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' })[c]) + '' + String((e.updatedDate ? DateTime.fromISO(e.updatedDate).toRelative() : '') ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' })[c]) + '' + String(e.updatedBy ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' })[c]) + '' + String((e.assignees ?? []).join(', ') ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' })[c]) + '
' }}
